answer: To block fake identities, each agent locks a bond decaying like quartz weathering: full weight only while fresh, losing 5% each epoch unless honest work renews it. A newcomer starts on a narrow tundra of trust and needs 20 epochs of proven work to reach the meadow of full rewards. An honest agent pays one bond, so rewards stay undiluted. But 100 fakes need 100 bonds, each decaying without real work, so upkeep costs more than rewards they harvest.
